argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.8.1: Introduce claims and distinguish opposing claims; organize logical reasons and relevant evidence from accurate credible sources, connect claims/reasons/evidence/counterclaims, maintain formal style and conclude.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.8.1: Use verbals and active/passive or conditional/subjunctive forms appropriately; avoid inappropriate voice/mood shifts.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.8.2: Use commas/ellipses/dashes for pauses, ellipses for omissions and correct spelling.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.8.3: Use verb voice/mood deliberately for particular effects.
